Stylelint v18.0.0 (under development now) will cause the config error below.
This prevents the error and keeps the compatibility with Stylelint v17.

Run:

```shell
npm it --save-dev 'stylelint/stylelint#v18' --allow-git=all
```

Raises:

```
ConfigurationError: Could not find "./lib". Do you need to install the package, use the "configBasedir" option or add the filename and extension to the path?
